zh-TW: 籌資活動的現金流量統計
籌資活動之淨現金流量
en: Net cash from (used in) financing activities

note.zh-TW: 模板原文寫「籌資活動的現金流量統計」，「統計」是「總計」的用詞錯誤；網站顯示修正寫法，模板原字列為別名。
note.en: The template label uses a wrong word for total; the site shows the corrected wording and keeps the original as a searchable alias.

definition.zh-TW:
籌資活動所有流入與流出加總之後的淨額。

它告訴你公司這段期間從股東與債權人淨拿到或淨還回多少現金。
definition.en:
The net of all financing inflows and outflows.

It tells you how much cash the company netted from, or returned to, shareholders and lenders during the period.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表籌資活動區的最後一列。故事剛成立時股東出資讓它是正數；借款再還清之後，借款的部分互相抵銷。它和營業、投資活動的總計相加就是現金及約當現金增減額。
example.en: Where it sits: the last line of the financing section of the statement of cash flows. At the start of the story the owners’ investment makes it positive; once the loan is taken and repaid, the borrowing lines cancel out. Added to the operating and investing totals it gives the net change in cash and cash equivalents.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為籌資活動為正代表公司賺錢。它只是表示公司這段期間淨借入或募到了錢；賺不賺錢要看損益表，本業現金要看營業活動。
misconception.en: Reading a positive financing total as a sign of profit. It only means the company raised more than it returned during the period; profit is on the income statement and core cash generation is in operating activities.

formula.zh-TW: 籌資活動的現金流量總計 ＝ 短期借款收入 ＋ 長期借款收入 ＋ 發行股票收入 － 短期借款返還 － 長期借款返還 － 支付股息。
formula.en: Net cash from financing activities = proceeds from short-term and long-term borrowings + proceeds from issuing shares － repayments of short-term and long-term borrowings － dividends paid.
